title: Colorado's 8th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: Colorado's 8th Congressional District, created after the 2020 census, is one of the most competitive House seats in the country. Incumbent Republican Rep. Gabe Evans, who flipped the seat in 2024 by defeating Democrat Yadira Caraveo 49.0%-48.2%, is running for re-election unopposed in the Republican primary. Two Democrats — former state Rep. Shannon Bird and state Rep. Manny Rutinel — are competing in the June 30 Democratic primary to determine who will face Evans in the November general election. The Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, and Sabato's Crystal Ball all rate the race as a toss-up, and the outcome could help determine which party controls the House.
polling_note: No general election polls found for this race as of mid-June 2026. The New York Times poll tracker lists the race but shows no public polls yet for the general election matchup. The Democratic primary is still ongoing (June 30, 2026).

candidates.name: Gabe Evans
candidates.summary: Gabe Evans is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Colorado's 8th Congressional District, first elected in 2024. He is a former U.S. Army captain who served in Afghanistan and a former lieutenant with the Arvada Police Department, and previously served in the Colorado House of Representatives. Evans is running for re-election unopposed in the Republican primary and has been endorsed by Donald Trump.

candidates.name: Shannon Bird
candidates.summary: Shannon Bird is a former Colorado state representative who served from 2019 to 2026, representing parts of Adams County, and previously served on the Westminster City Council. She resigned from the state legislature in January 2026 to focus on her congressional campaign, where she emphasizes healthcare affordability, immigration reform, and standing up to the Trump administration. Bird has positioned herself as a moderate Democrat and highlights her experience on the Joint Budget Committee and her record of holding over 90 town halls.

candidates.name: Manny Rutinel
candidates.summary: Manny Rutinel is a Colorado state representative for the 32nd district, serving since October 2023, and an environmental attorney. A first-generation American raised by a single mother, he previously worked as an economist for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and as an associate attorney at Earthjustice. Rutinel is running on a platform of lowering costs, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and holding the Trump administration accountable, with strong support from progressive groups.
